content_sections.heading: DRDO DYSL SM Junior Research Fellow Vacancy 2026
Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: B.E/B.Tech. in Mechanical/Mechatronics Engineering with First Class with a valid GATE score OR M.E./M.Tech. with First class in Mechanical/Mechatronics / Robotics & Automation/Machine Design/Solid Mechanics and B.E/B.Tech in Mechanical/Mechatronics Engineering with First class. Desirable: Working knowledge of finite element packages, CAD, 3D Printing, Composite Materials, basic electronics and instrumentation.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age: 28 years Age Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC candidates. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: DRDO DYSL SM Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Selection Process
content_sections.text: Screening based on GATE score and marks Walk-in Interview

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post being advertised by DRDO DYSL SM?
faq.answer: DRDO DYSL SM is recruiting for the post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) through a walk-in interview process.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the JRF post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 06-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.E/B.Tech in Mechanical/Mechatronics with a valid GATE score or M.E./M.Tech in relevant fields with First Class.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the JRF post is 28 years, with relaxations applicable for SC/ST and OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves screening based on GATE score and marks, followed by a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at DRDO Young Scientists Laboratory for Smart Materials, Hyderabad, Telangana.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original documents, self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates if applicable.
